description: Download a print-ready file of one of the account's codes, in its saved design: SVG (default; vector, any size, best for print shops), PNG (size_px wide, 300 dpi) or a vector PDF sized to width_in inches. The file comes back as an embedded resource (SVG, PDF) or an image (PNG). For content that isn't saved in the account, use create_static_code instead. At most 120 files an hour per account. Read only; works with any key.

code.description: The code: its id from list_codes, or a changeable code's link ending (e.g. "menu" for makemyqrcodes.com/menu)

size_px.description: PNG only: width in pixels, 200 to 2000. Default 1200

width_in.description: PDF only: printed width in inches, 0.5 to 40. Default 2

name: download_code
title: Download a code
